tools.name: pdf_tables_to_excel
tools.description: Extract all tables detected in a PDF into an Excel (.xlsx) workbook, one worksheet per table. Input: the PDF file's contents as a base64-encoded string (max 25 MB, 500 pages; tables need visible ruling lines or clearly aligned columns). Returns a download_url for the .xlsx file (link valid 24 hours)

tools.name: merge_pdfs
tools.description: Merge two or more PDF files into a single PDF, in the order given. Input: a list of base64-encoded PDF file contents (each max 25 MB / 500 pages). Returns a download_url for the merged PDF (link valid 24 hours), its size and page count. Costs 1 credit; 5 free calls per month.

tools.name: images_to_pdf
tools.description: Combine one or more images (PNG/JPEG/WebP) into a single PDF, one image per page, pages sized to each image. Input: a list of base64-encoded image contents (each max 15 MB / 40 MP). Returns a download_url for the PDF (link valid 24 hours), its size and page count. Costs 1 credit; 5 free calls per mo

tools.name: pdf_form_fill
tools.description: Fill the fields of a fillable PDF form and return the completed form. Input: the PDF's contents as a base64-encoded string, plus a fields object mapping field names to values.
